# iAUTOHAUS

> One-stop-shop for luxury car drivers in Tempe, Arizona: used luxury sales, service and repair, and a vehicle spa.

Concept note: this file is part of an unofficial Kerblabs design concept. Facts come from iautohaus.com. Confirm details with the business.

## Business
- Address: 1876 E. Broadway Rd, Tempe, AZ 85282
- Sales phone: 480-317-0777
- Service phone: 480-317-0783
- Instagram: @iautohaus

## Services
- Used luxury car sales, with trade-in valuations and auto financing
- Service and repair by ASE-certified technicians
- iAUTOHAUS Vehicle Spa (on-site detailing)
- Nationwide and international shipping

## Marques
- Alfa Romeo, Audi, Bentley, BMW, Ferrari, Jaguar, Land Rover, Maserati, Mercedes-Benz, Mini, Porsche, Range Rover, Rivian, Rolls Royce, Sprinter, Tesla, Volkswagen, Volvo

## Areas served
- Phoenix, Scottsdale, Paradise Valley, Chandler, Gilbert, Mesa, Tempe, Queen Creek
